text:
maria_fin: Heads up — OrionB got two March invoices; one of them is missing the reserved compute line and the amounts don't match. Seen by support yet? @olivia_support :eyes:

olivia_support: Ugh. Can you paste invoice IDs and any PDFs? I'll escalate.

maria_fin: Invoice IDs: inv-2026-03-orionb-1187 and inv-2026-03-orionb-1187-dup. The dup has total $12,470, original $9,120. PDF attached in ticket #4872 (link).

ben_billing: Noted. Billing-bot shows a double-send for batch_id=202603-047 in the job logs around 2026-03-02T02:14Z. Could be a retry loop.

billing-bot: automated note: invoice_generation_job batch_id=202603-047 retried (attempts=2) status=success. Generated invoices: [inv-2026-03-orionb-1187, inv-2026-03-orionb-1187]. Hash collision check: failed-to-detect-duplicate.

jake_engineer: Looking now. Quick find: the job uses external_batch_id derived from the webhook id, we had a short circuit where the external id was blank for ~3s due to a race in the webhook handler — duplicates got processed. Also one of the invoice_line mappings for reserved_compute used pricing_key="reserved_v2" but the DB had "reserved_v2.0" (string diff) so the line failed to attach on the first run.

nina_ops: So two problems: duplicate generation + mapping mismatch that drops the reserved line. Correct?

jake_engineer: Exactly. The duplicate explains the doubled amount, the mapping explains the missing line on one of the copies. Repro steps: run job simulation with batch_id=202603-047 and you see invoice lines length 4 vs 5 depending on mapping lookup.

olivia_support: Customer is upset. They flagged it as overcharge. They want a corrected invoice and a void for the duplicate. Can finance reissue and void once engineering patches?

maria_fin: Yes. Plan: (1) void inv-2026-03-orionb-1187-dup, (2) reissue corrected invoice for inv-2026-03-orionb-1187 with reserved line added, (3) credit the customer for any transient overcharge. Will wait for eng confirmation before step 1.

jake_engineer: I'll push a hotfix to add idempotency: dedupe on external_batch_id if present, and strict fallback to "unknown" rather than blank. Also add a CI rule to assert mapping keys exist. Patch ID: CHORE-5934.

ben_billing: After patch deploy, we should run a replay for batch_id=202603-047 with --dry-run first. Command I propose: `billing-replay --batch 202603-047 --dry-run --dedupe-key external_batch_id` then `billing-replay --batch 202603-047 --apply` if dry-run matches expected.

maria_fin: Sounds good. Olivia, open a support doc for the customer with the timeline and expected credits. I'll prepare the void/reissue once Jake confirms the replay outcome.

olivia_support: On it. Ticket updated with timeline + customer note.

billing-bot: automated note: CHORE-5934 deployed to staging at 2026-03-02T15:20Z.

jake_engineer: Staging replay dry-run completed: duplicate detected and mapping correction adds the reserved line. Output checksum matches expected invoice schema. I will schedule prod replay in 30m after small smoke tests.

maria_fin: Thanks — once prod replay finishes, I'll run the void/reissue flow and confirm with @olivia_support before notifying the customer.

olivia_support: Thanks team :pray:

ben_billing: Follow-up action items: 1) Deploy CHORE-5934 to prod (jake), 2) Run replay for batch 202603-047 with dedupe (jake/nina), 3) Finance to void dup & reissue (maria), 4) Update billing pipeline to assert mapping keys (eng + billing), 5) Postmortem + runbook update (owner: ben).
